body: Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to human preferences, after pre-training and supervised fine-tuning steps. However, standard RL alignment steps such as RLHF do not focus on factuality of LLMs, hence they may generate non-factual information, which could result in unintended consequences. In response, a number of factuality alignment approaches have been proposed in the literature which claim to improve factuality of LLMs on their own benchmarks. However, these methods have not been reproduced independently and are also not comparable since each uses a different base model, training data, evaluation set, judge, and metric. In this paper, we present the first independent reproduction of five factuality alignment methods, which span on-policy RL (PPO, GRPO, and Dr.~GRPO) and offline preference optimization (DPO and KTO), and compare them on a common benchmark with common evaluation metrics. We found that none of these methods reproduces in full, and on the common benchmark none of the methods significantly outperforms the base model. On closer inspection, the rewards optimize for format, length, or brevity rather than factuality and relevance, whereas the choice between on-policy and offline training matters little. Furthermore, the evaluation metrics and benchmarks are also part of the problem since they do not measure relevance of text to the prompt. Since there is no ground truth associated with the prompts, the reliance on LLM judges and retrieval for verification also makes the evaluation fragile. We release our code, data, and checkpoints.
summaryZh: 本文对五种主流的大模型事实性对齐方法（包括PPO、GRPO、DPO等）进行了首次独立复现与公平对比。研究发现，这些方法在统一基准下均未能显著优于基础模型，且现有的奖励机制往往倾向于优化格式、长度或简洁性，而非事实准确性。此外，由于缺乏地面真值，依赖LLM作为裁判的评估方式存在脆弱性。该研究通过开源代码与数据，揭示了当前事实性对齐研究中存在的评估偏差，呼吁行业建立更科学的评估标准。

glossary.explanationZh: 事实性对齐，指通过训练使模型输出更符合客观事实的技术。
基于人类反馈的强化学习，用于将模型行为与人类偏好对齐。
在线策略强化学习，指在训练过程中使用当前策略采样数据。
离线偏好优化，指基于静态偏好数据集对模型进行优化。
大模型裁判，指使用更强大的模型来评估其他模型的输出质量。
